grammar_title: 过去完成时及其被动语态(had done / had been done)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 5 Discovering Useful Structures:过去完成时(主动 had done)、过去完成被动(had been done)、过去完成与一般过去的时态对照(by the time / before / after / no sooner…than / hardly…when)。句子地道、急救/事件先后主题、答案唯一(时间关系决定时态)。

points.point: 过去完成时(主动)表「过去的过去」
points.overview: 两个过去动作中,先发生的那个用过去完成时 had done;常与 when / by + 过去时间 / before / already / by the time 连用,表示在某个过去时间点之前已完成或已持续。

points.point: 过去完成时被动 had been done
points.overview: 当「过去的过去」里的动作是被动(主语承受动作)时,用 had been done。例如:伤口在护士包扎前已被清洗 → The wound had been cleaned。

points.point: 过去完成 vs 一般过去的时态对照
points.overview: by the time / before / after / no sooner…than / hardly…when 等连接两个过去动作:先发生的用过去完成,后发生的用一般过去;倒装结构 No sooner had…than / Hardly had…when 固定搭配。

questions.stem: When the doctor arrived, the man ____ breathing.
questions.explanation: '医生到达'是过去,'停止呼吸'发生在更早 → 过去的过去用 had stopped。

questions.stem: By 2010, the nurse ____ in that hospital for ten years.
questions.explanation: by + 过去时间,表示到那个过去时间点已持续 → had worked。

questions.stem: By the time the ambulance came, the boy ____ first aid to his grandfather.
questions.explanation: '救护车来'是过去,'已给急救'更早 → had given。

questions.stem: She ____ the burn under cool water before the swelling got worse.
questions.explanation: before 引导另一过去动作,'放在水下'更早 → had put。

questions.stem: When we reached the table, the diner ____ already on the floor.
questions.explanation: '我们到达'是过去,'倒下'更早且 already → had fallen。

questions.stem: Chen reacted fast because he ____ how to give first aid at school.
questions.explanation: '反应快'是过去,'学过急救'在更早 → had learned。

questions.stem: Before the paramedics came, the friends ____ him several times on the back.
questions.explanation: before + 过去,'拍背'更早 → had slapped。

questions.stem: By the time help arrived, the elderly woman ____ for almost an hour.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去,表示已持续 → had waited。

questions.stem: The victim ____ a lot of blood before anyone noticed the wound.
questions.explanation: before 引导后发生的过去动作,'失血'更早 → had lost。

questions.stem: When the operator answered, the boy ____ his grandfather on his back.
questions.explanation: '接线员接听'是过去,'已让爷爷躺下'更早 → had laid。

questions.stem: She realised that she ____ the medicine at home by mistake.
questions.explanation: '意识到'是过去,'把药落下'发生在更早 → had left。

questions.stem: By the time the doctor checked him, the patient ____ to breathe again.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去,'重新呼吸'更早 → had begun。

questions.stem: When I got to the kitchen, my brother ____ his hand on the hot pan.
questions.explanation: '我到厨房'是过去,'烫到手'更早 → had burned。

questions.stem: Mrs Taylor ____ her phone to call for help before she fell over.
questions.explanation: before + 过去,'设置好手机'更早 → had set。

questions.stem: He told us that he ____ a first-aid course the year before.
questions.explanation: '告诉'是过去,'上过课'在更早的一年 → had taken。

questions.stem: By the time the lifeguard reached him, the swimmer ____ under the water.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去,'沉入水下'更早 → had gone。

questions.stem: When the nurse came back, the child ____ the whole glass of water.
questions.explanation: '护士回来'是过去,'喝完水'更早 → had swallowed。

questions.stem: She felt better because the doctors ____ her the right treatment.
questions.explanation: '感觉好转'是过去,'给治疗'在更早 → had given。

questions.stem: Before the ambulance left, the team ____ all of his vital signs.
questions.explanation: before + 过去,'检查体征'更早 → had checked。

questions.stem: By midnight, the pain in her swollen ankle ____ a little.
questions.explanation: by + 过去时间,表示到那时已减轻 → had eased。

questions.stem: The wound ____ before the nurse bandaged it.
questions.explanation: 伤口是被清洗(被动),且在包扎前已完成 → had been cleaned。

questions.stem: When we got there, the victim ____ to hospital already.
questions.explanation: 受害者被送(被动),在我们到达前已完成 → had been taken。

questions.stem: By the time the fire stopped, the burnt area ____ with a loose cloth.
questions.explanation: 烧伤处被盖住(被动),火停前已完成 → had been covered。

questions.stem: She found that her phone ____ to call an emergency number at one touch.
questions.explanation: 手机被预先设置(被动),'发现'之前已完成 → had been set up。

questions.stem: Before the doctor came, the obstruction ____ out of the man's throat.
questions.explanation: 阻塞物被推出(被动),医生来前已完成 → had been forced。

questions.stem: When the team arrived, an IV needle ____ into the patient's arm.
questions.explanation: 注射针被插入(被动),急救队到达前已完成 → had been put。

questions.stem: By the time she woke up, her cut ____ and bandaged.
questions.explanation: 伤口被清洗(被动),她醒前已完成 → had been cleaned。

questions.stem: He realised that the medicine ____ on the table by his mother.
questions.explanation: 药被留下(被动),'意识到'之前已完成 → had been left。

questions.stem: When the ambulance arrived, the victim ____ on his back by his friends.
questions.explanation: 受害者被放平(被动),救护车到达前已完成 → had been laid。

questions.stem: Before the lesson ended, the steps of CPR ____ to the whole class.
questions.explanation: 步骤被教(被动),课结束前已完成 → had been taught。

questions.stem: She was glad that the burn ____ under cool water in good time.
questions.explanation: 烧伤处被放在水下(被动),'高兴'之前已完成 → had been placed。

questions.stem: By the time the doctors left, the patient ____ that he was fine.
questions.explanation: 病人被告知(被动),医生离开前已完成 → had been told。

questions.stem: When the rescue team came, the swimmer ____ out of the water already.
questions.explanation: 游泳者被拉上岸(被动),救援队到达前已完成 → had been pulled。

questions.stem: Before the manager checked, the first-aid kit ____ near the door.
questions.explanation: 急救箱被放置(被动),检查前已完成 → had been placed。

questions.stem: She found that the loose clothes ____ off with scissors before she woke.
questions.explanation: 衣服被剪掉(被动),她醒前已完成 → had been taken。

questions.stem: By the time we reached the ward, his vital signs ____ twice.
questions.explanation: 体征被检查(被动),到达病房前已完成 → had been checked。

questions.stem: When the boy hung up, an ambulance ____ to his home already.
questions.explanation: 救护车被派出(被动),挂电话前已完成 → had been sent。

questions.stem: Before the family arrived, the wound ____ with a clean cloth.
questions.explanation: 伤口被包扎(被动),家人到达前已完成 → had been wrapped。

questions.stem: She was sure the oxygen ____ to the patient before the trip to hospital.
questions.explanation: 氧气被给予(被动),去医院前已完成 → had been given。

questions.stem: By the time the news spread, thousands of lives ____ by the new method.
questions.explanation: 生命被挽救(被动),消息传开前已完成 → had been saved。

questions.stem: By the time the operator answered, the old man ____ to breathe.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去,先发生的'停止呼吸'用过去完成 → had stopped。

questions.stem: The ambulance ____ as soon as the boy finished the call.
questions.explanation: as soon as 连接的两个动作几乎同时,'到达'用一般过去 → arrived。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ the steak than he began to choke.
questions.explanation: No sooner 置于句首要倒装,且先发生用过去完成 → had he swallowed。

questions.stem: Hardly had Chen sat down ____ he heard someone scream.
questions.explanation: Hardly…when 是固定搭配,意为'刚……就……'。

questions.stem: After she ____ the burn under cool water, she covered it with a cloth.
questions.explanation: after 引导先发生的动作,用过去完成 → had placed。

questions.stem: When the doctors finally came, they ____ that he was already fine.
questions.explanation: 主句'发现'在过去这一刻发生,用一般过去 → found。

questions.stem: No sooner had the team given him oxygen ____ his colour came back.
questions.explanation: No sooner…than 固定搭配,意为'一……就……'。

questions.stem: Before the nurse arrived, the friends ____ everything they could.
questions.explanation: before 引导后发生的'到达',先发生的'尝试'用过去完成 → had tried。

questions.stem: Hardly ____ the floor when she heard the front door open.
questions.explanation: Hardly 置于句首要倒装,且先发生用过去完成 → had she reached。

questions.stem: After he ____ the Heimlich manoeuvre, the food was forced out.
questions.explanation: after 引导先发生的动作,用过去完成 → had done。

questions.stem: By the time we got the leaflet, the first-aid class ____ already.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去 + already,先发生的'结束'用过去完成 → had finished。

questions.stem: She ____ the emergency number the moment she saw him collapse.
questions.explanation: the moment 连接的动作几乎同时,'拨号'用一般过去 → dialled。

questions.stem: No sooner had the bleeding stopped ____ the patient opened his eyes.
questions.explanation: No sooner…than 固定搭配。

questions.stem: After the wound ____ cleaned, the nurse put a bandage on it.
questions.explanation: after 引导先发生的被动动作,用过去完成被动 had been (cleaned)。

questions.stem: Hardly had he made a fist ____ he began the chest pushes.
questions.explanation: Hardly…when 固定搭配。

questions.stem: When the lights came back on, the boy ____ already given first aid.
questions.explanation: '灯亮'是过去,'已做急救'更早 → had (already given)。

questions.stem: Before the manoeuvre ____ invented, many choking victims had died.
questions.explanation: before 引导后发生(被发明)的动作,用一般过去被动 was invented;主句'已死亡'才用过去完成。

questions.stem: After the victim ____ to hospital, his family felt much calmer.
questions.explanation: after 引导先发生的被动动作,用过去完成被动 had been taken。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ he stood up than he felt the pain in his ankle.
questions.explanation: No sooner 句首倒装,先发生用过去完成 → had he stood。

questions.stem: By the time the radio programme ended, she ____ all the first-aid steps.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去,先发生的'记下步骤'用过去完成 → had noted。
